verdict.rationale: The pack never says whether meeting data is used to train AI models. It documents no org-level training opt-out and does not mention SOC 2 or HIPAA. The security page covers adjacent controls only: private storage, a 0-day data retention policy with vendors, and a Rules Engine for meeting access and privacy. None of these addresses training use, an opt-out, or compliance attestations.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the vendor documents whether meeting data trains AI models and gives my org an enforceable opt-out, alongside SOC 2 / HIPAA posture
